scope: Metrics are file-specific: they describe the scored fields of this capture against the supplied annotations. Every annotated field was aligned and scored.

manifest.name: TRACE controlled fixture v1
manifest.description: Fictional HTTP/1.1 traffic built by examples/generate_groundtruth_fixture.py. Names and usernames are invented; every span was recorded when the text was constructed. Contains hard negatives (companies, places, products, identifier look-alikes, given-name look-alikes).

rules_only.description: Deterministic rules only (whole-field USERNAME / PERSON_NAME_CANDIDATE findings).

rules_plus_model.description: Union of rule and model predictions; an identical span from both counts once.

notes: Metrics describe this capture and these annotations only; they are not a general accuracy claim for TRACE or the model.
Spans are matched exactly (same field, label, start and end in code points); near-misses count as an error.
Confidence intervals are Wilson binomial intervals that treat spans as independent; no F1 interval is computed.
Rule findings for USERNAME and PERSON_NAME_CANDIDATE cover the whole field value and are scored as whole-field spans.
